description:
From the fz-kdt.183 research (2026-09-03). `cargo test --release --lib
metadata_macro_rejects_duplicate_keys` -> "test did not panic as expected at
src/telemetry/event_test.rs:36". The test is #[should_panic(expected =
"duplicate telemetry key")] over a debug_assert! (src/telemetry/event.rs:
29-35); [profile.release] (Cargo.toml:57-59) sets no debug-assertions, so the
assertion is compiled out and the release lib run reads 1589 passed / 1
FAILED at d2a5f3510. Either the duplicate-key rejection is a real invariant
(make it an assert!, or a Result the macro surfaces) or the test is debug-
only and must say so (#[cfg(debug_assertions)]). A gate that only passes in
one profile is not a gate.
title: telemetry metadata_macro_rejects_duplicate_keys is red under --release: a should_panic over a debug_assert
